Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing interpretation retained: Truth said of a thing is its conformity to the intellect on which it depends in being, rather than its being believed or observed. This is the ontological sense used to interpret the quarta via’s verum, not sentence truth, confidence, or frequency of endorsement. Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing interpretation retained: For this reading, x is more true than y in the relevant respect when x more fully realizes the intelligible nature or form under consideration: the comparison is of realization of that form, hence of intelligibility grounded in actuality. It is a relation between efficient causes, distinct from the mover link `MovesAsMoved` (DEF-PER-SE-ORDERED-SERIES); STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK is the explicit premise that every per se mover link is such a cause link. Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing resolution retained: Aquinas draws this distinction himself (ST I q.48 a.2 ad 2). Stage 1 uses only being as the entity of a thing: the domain `Being`, the respect `esse` (DEF-ESSE) and 'maximal in being'. Being as the truth of a proposition appears only in STMT-EVIL-IS-AS-PROPOSITIONAL-TRUTH, where 'there is evil' is the truth (`Holds`) of a sentence. Sentences and beings are different Lean types, so no result can pass from 'evil is' to 'evil is a being' or count a privation as in act with respect to esse. What the definitions do not settle is whether being admits of more and less (`MoreIn esse`) across categories; that is carried by the premises that use the primitive comparative (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING), not by the word. Aristotle's many senses of being (STMT-BEING-HAS-SEVERAL-SENSES) are senses of being as entity. Whether being is said univocally or analogically, and so whether it is a genus, is a separate axis recorded in DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY and DISAMB-GENUS.

Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing resolution retained: The sources read here take being analogically: Aristotle's pros hen (STMT-BEING-SAID-PROS-HEN), Aquinas' analogy of divine names (STMT-DIVINE-NAMES-ANALOGICAL), being as the first analogical predicate (STMT-BEING-FIRST-ANALOGICAL-PREDICATE), and grades of being by approach to God (STMT-BEING-MEASURED-BY-APPROACH-TO-GOD). The quarta via premises that speak of more and less in being (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING, STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS) are to be read in this analogical sense. Their Lean form does not encode it: `MoreIn esse` is a primitive comparative compatible with both senses. The two senses now have order models (DEF-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE for the univocal sense, DEF-ORDER-BY-APPROACH-TO-A-PRIMARY for attribution), and DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING records, premise by premise, which survive on which model. The source-bound STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-AT-LEAST-AS-SUCH requires a shared defining account (DEF-SHARED-DEFINING-ACCOUNT); STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH drops that condition and remains an unattributed open premise; STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-MORE-SUCH retains the condition but adds strict superiority and likewise remains unattributed. Applying either to analogical being needs independent justification; analogy and failure of a shared account are not identified. The attribution-order result STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH derives a primary-as-cause comparison under strict primacy and gives a countermodel to unrestricted comparison; it does not establish synonymy or source the unrestricted use with the primary as effect in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING.

Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing resolution retained: The no-regress premise STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES is stated only for per se links (`MovesAsMoved`); nothing on the root path says that a per accidens series must end. ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 grants that a per accidens series (an infinite past of fathers or hammers) is not impossible (STMT-INFINITE-REGRESS-IMPOSSIBLE-ONLY-IN-PER-SE-SERIES), so an eternal world does not touch the prima via. The series is per se because of STMT-SECOND-MOVERS-MOVE-ONLY-AS-MOVED, and it is read at one time (simul). The secunda via has its own per se link between efficient causes, `CausesAsCaused` (DEF-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-LINK), with its own no-regress premise STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES. It is not identified with `MovesAsMoved`: the only passage from one to the other is the explicit premise STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK (q.46 a.2 ad 7, the stone, stick and hand), from which AQUINAS-ST-I-Q46-A2-AD7-MOVER-REGRESS-FROM-CAUSE-REGRESS derives the mover regress premise.

Reuse unchanged prior audit disposition: Existing resolution retained: The prima via itself defines moving as educing from potency to act (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-REDUCED-BY-A-MOVER-A), and the case reads motus in that broad sense. Aristotle's physical change is one kind of such reduction, so the observation premise STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD holds on either reading. All premises share `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` over an abstract `Respect`, so the formal results hold for any one reading applied throughout; an objection that the regress premises hold only for local motion is an objection to a premise, not an equivocation. Scope (#404): the typed Physics readings (TruthCore.Greek.Aristotle.Physics.Typed, docs/typed-physics.md) read `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` as physical motion. A universal prima via premise restricts to physical motion, so results that use prima via premises to derive typed Physics statements stay within one reading. The converse does not hold: Physics premises about physical motion do not extend to every reduction from potency to act. VIII.4's division and its conclusions therefore carry an explicit guard for respects of physical motion (`IsPhysicalRespect`, DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT); its other readings are scoped by their antecedent primitives (forced, natural, self-, passive natural motion are kinds of physical motion by definition); the III.3 and VIII.5 readings carry no guard and are accepted only under a physical instantiation of `MovedIn`/`MovesIn`. The VIII.4 readings yield STMT-EVERY-PHYSICAL-MOTION-HAS-A-PER-SE-MOVER. They reach the root premise STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER only through the explicit, unattributed scope premise STMT-EVERY-REDUCTION-TO-ACT-IS-PHYSICAL-MOTION (result ARIST-PHYS-VIII-4-SCOPE-BRIDGE-TO-PRIMA-VIA), which is open and false on the broad reading if some reduction is not a physical motion. BRIDGE-ARIST-MOTION-ANALYSIS-MOVED-AS-IN-POTENCY reads Physics III.1's definition (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY) with the same `MovedIn` as STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY. Aristotle states the definition for physical change; applied to the broad reading it is the definition extended to every reduction from potency to act, and the bridge carries his support to the premise only as far as that extension holds. Moving as an end (#352): Met. XII.7's unmoved mover moves as an object of love (ὡς ἐρώμενον, 1072b3; In Metaph. XII, lect. 7 n. 1-3, sicut desiderabile, the heaven's motion being for its sake and caused by a proximate mover). The Lambda.7 readings (STMT-SOME-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE, STMT-EVERY-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE) read the case's MovesIn to include moving as an end: on the broad reading, what moves as an end is that for whose sake a potency is reduced to act. This is an unattributed reading choice, not a claim that Aristotle's mover is an efficient mover. ARIST-MET-XII-7-FIRST-MOVER-PURE-ACT depends on it: its uniqueness step identifies the prima via's first mover with Lambda.7's mover through the same MovesIn. If MovesIn is read as efficient moving only, the Lambda.7 mover need not satisfy IsFirstUnmovedMover and the step fails. Lambda.7's 'unmoved' and 'in no way otherwise' are read over the respects of change (DEF-RESPECT-OF-CHANGE); their extension to every respect, for a mover that moves something and is unmoved and unable to be otherwise in every respect of change, is the unattributed STMT-UNCHANGEABLE-IN-RESPECTS-OF-CHANGE-IS-UNCHANGEABLE-SIMPLY.
